immutability_contract.raw: Content-addressed immutable provider record including payload hash and acquisition lineage.
immutability_contract.silver: Versioned normalized record referencing Raw IDs and a fixed transform version.
immutability_contract.pit: Append-only knowledge version whose available_to is closed by the next visible revision.
immutability_contract.manifest: Deterministic identity over every file path, SHA-256, byte size and temporal contract.
immutability_contract.collision_rule: An existing path with different bytes is a hard failure.
immutability_contract.tamper_rule: Any file hash, byte-size or manifest-identity mismatch blocks replay.

pit_contract.selection_rule: available_from <= decision_cutoff and (available_to is null or decision_cutoff < available_to)
pit_contract.timezone_rule: Every timestamp must be ISO-8601 timezone-aware.
pit_contract.backfill_rule: Availability may precede local first_seen_at only with a documented provider publication/effective-time basis and evidence reference.
pit_contract.first_seen_rule: Records using first_seen_at as their basis may never be backdated.
pit_contract.revision_rule: A replay may select at most one knowledge version for a normalized event.

requirements: provider-specific acquisition adapter with no credential persistence
written storage and replay rights where provider terms are ambiguous
two independent pulls with content-hash comparison
offline replay from a frozen manifest
